# AIVIA provider capability matrix

<!-- Generated by `aivia providers docs`; do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Regenerate: aivia providers docs --output docs/PROVIDERS.md -->

This matrix is generated from the metadata every registered provider declares. Capabilities come from `ProviderMeta.capabilities`, prices from `ProviderMeta.pricing`, and limits and licensing from the corresponding metadata fields. A dash means the provider does not declare a value. Metadata is read without constructing a provider, so runtime-only values are not included.
